summary: Completed comprehensive E2E testing of SignalForge AI Crypto Trading Platform V1. Backend: 38/38 tests passed (100%). Frontend: Core UI and integrations working, AI signals generating successfully with both Claude and Gemini models, backtesting functional with full results display. Critical issues: Paper trading button not clickable due to overlay, sign out not redirecting, 401 handling broken.

backend_issues.notes: All 38 backend API tests passed with 100% success rate. Auth, market data, AI signals, backtesting, paper trading, watchlists, alerts, and settings endpoints all working correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Button not clickable - overlay intercepting pointer events. HTML element blocking clicks despite button being visible and enabled.
ui_bugs.impact: Users cannot place paper trades, blocking core functionality

integration_issues.issue: Sign out button clicks but does not redirect to landing/login page. User remains on current page after logout.
Unauthenticated users can access protected routes like /dashboard without being redirected to /login
integration_issues.impact: Security issue - auth guard not working properly
